There are rocks and trees in the upper left, with clouds and smoke near a banner on a pole. Trees and a distant landscape fill the upper right. In the centre, a tall figure in a crested headdress stands near two officials in winged caps. A robed figure bows before them. Groups of robed attendants and onlookers stand on the left and right. In the lower half, many shaven-headed figures, perhaps monks, are partly hidden among dense trees and shrubs. In the lower right is a walled building or gate with a horizontal plaque, and more heads appear below it.</image-desc>

# 四卦

<image-desc size="large" type="diagram" significance="high">A ruled grid of 16 columns and 6 rows that charts the lines of sixteen hexagrams. Their names are printed across the top. Read from right to left they are 姤, 大過, 鼎, 恒, 巽, 井, 蠱, 升, 訟, 困, 未濟, 解, 渙, 坎, 蒙, 師. The grid has four labels. 巽 sits in the fourth row, in the columns under 恒 and 巽. 陽 sits in the fifth row, under 訟 and 困. 坎 is printed in white on a black block in the fourth row, under 渙 and 解. 陰 is printed in white on a black block in the bottom row, under 蒙 and 師. The black blocks seem to mark yin regions and the white areas yang regions.</image-desc>

<image-desc size="large" type="diagram" significance="high">Woodblock diagram of the "Hanging Clouds" battle formation (雲垂陣). Black and white circles stand for troop units. Lines join them into a roughly symmetrical arrangement that widens toward the bottom, with a central axis and two flanking wings. Each unit sits on or beside a stylized cloud motif, and pennant-like flags rise from several of the clouds. Clouds with trigram labels are set around the edges: one at the top centre, one at each upper corner, one at each middle side, one at the bottom centre and one at each lower corner. Rows of black and white circles run across the lower part of the figure. Short labels name the "front" and "rear" divisions along the central axis.</image-desc>

## 指甲花
